en: Black‑and‑white commemorative postcard with decorative framing. At the top center is a photograph of a coastal fort and nearby buildings, labelled in Greek "ΑΥΓΟΥΣΤΟΣ 1824". Below is another coastal view with neoclassical buildings along the waterfront. On the left and right are oval portrait medallions of two men in formal attire, each framed with laurel and flags and captioned with their names in Greek. At the bottom center appears the date "ΝΟΕΜΒΡΙΟΣ 1912" and a printed publisher credit on the lower right.
